fact: On 6 March 2026 the FSU reported that the contract for extending 4G broadband to rural areas (Lots 1 and 2) was signed between PAFEN and Viettel Burundi, under the Universal Service Fund as contracting authority, with a Government subsidy of USD 4,370,277 of a USD 10 million total.
title: Extension de la connectivité numérique haut débit 4G en milieu rural
